notes: Deprecated package: every function is std (std::fs, std::io) or its os replacement (os::create_temp, os::mkdir_temp).

NopCloser.note: A reader needs no Close in Rust: use it as is.

ReadDir.note: FileInfo entries sorted by filename, as Go (std::fs::read_dir is unsorted).

WriteFile.note: Takes the permission bits Go's WriteFile creates the file with; std::fs::write cannot set them.
